doc.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

chapter: Biagini, Duke and the Shaw band
title: Billie Holiday and racism on the road with Shaw
summary: Incidents with Billie Holiday and Zutty Singleton in West Virginia, New England, and the Lincoln Hotel kitchen door.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You did some traveling in the south with Artie Shaw? When Billie Holiday was in the band, didn’t you?

Yeah. Not much. There was one incident that — Billie used to ride in my car, with Zutty Singleton also, who traveled with the band for a while in the summer of 1938. And we were in Ohio or someplace. But we went into West Virginia. And Zutty knew the area,

Parkersburg, West Virginia. I’d never been. So he told me where to stop, and there was a nice looking building, a three story building. And it was a hotel, but it was for black people. And he got out, and he said, “Billie, you’d better get out.” And she said, “No.” She said, “I’m going down with the rest of the guys.” He said, “You’ll be sorry. You’re down south.” And she muttered a few words. Anyway we went on down to the hotel and they said, “We’re all full” to her you know. So she got back in the car and I took her back to the hotel. That was one incident. But there were others, even in New England of all places.
Yeah. There were some cracks made when she walked into a dining room.
Did she have to come in through the kitchen door sometimes? That kind of thing?

Oh that part, you’re talking about the Lincoln Hotel in New York. I mean that’s where that — the bandstand at the Lincoln Hotel was facing the audience and the ballroom floor. To the right was a door to the kitchen at the other end of the bandstand. And all the tables and stuff were out in front. And the other entranceway, that was the Lincoln Hotel, and we had to come through the kitchen. Otherwise you’re walking right down through the — and we were used to that. I don’t know exactly what happened there, but maybe it was because Helen did not come through the kitchen — Helen Forrest — she was in the band with Billie. I think that would be right there, what that was.
